verdict.rationale: Deel's official MCP server exposes platform operations as tools, such as listOfContracts, createTimeOffRequest and calculateEorVersusEntityHiringCosts. Clients like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code can invoke these tools, and OAuth is handled automatically, so users can operate Deel through natural-language prompts. This works only through a third-party AI client, not a native in-product natural-language interface. Missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language command interface, evidence of how broadly the tools cover platform operations (e.g. payroll runs, contract creation), and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
